title: Derivative and coordinate sign correlation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p=(p_j)_{j\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)}$ satisfy $0<p_j<1$ for every coordinate, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and choose $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. Under the independent product distribution with coordinate parameters $p$, the expectation of the product of the discrete derivative $D_i f$ and the $i$th coordinate sign equals $(1-2p_i)$ times the expectation of $D_i f$.
hypotheses_covered: Each parameter $p_j$ lies strictly between $0$ and $1$
